text.kjv: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
text.rv1909: JEHOVA es mi pastor; nada me faltará.

text.kjv: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
text.rv1909: Porque de tal manera amó Dios al mundo, que ha dado á su Hijo unigénito, para que todo aquel que en él cree, no se pierda, mas tenga vida eterna.
